gene.identity: YALI1_D17462g (alias YALI2_D00285g; CLIB122 twin YALI0_D14300g); no verified native name; A1 aspartic peptidase candidate (secreted type, signal peptide 1-17); automatic database annotation and sequence family only.

gpr_evidence_basis.before: Explicit user instruction; existing sequence and AlphaFold evidence supports an alternative protein function
gpr_evidence_basis.after: Identity review 2026-10-19: the former GPR gene YALI1D17462g (NCBI Gene 2910235, XP_502815.3, 384 aa) carries only A1 aspartic peptidase signatures (Pfam PF00026, PROSITE PS00141 at both active-site motifs) and no argininosuccinate synthase signature, and no W29 gene is annotated for argininosuccinate synthase.

gpr_evidence_label.before: 用户指定赋值；功能证据冲突，未实验确认
gpr_evidence_label.after: No gene assigned: the W29 argininosuccinate synthase locus is unannotated; not experimentally confirmed

r153_model_interpretation.before: User-specified single-gene assignment for cytosolic argininosuccinate synthesis; YALIUNK2 removed. Deleting YALI1D17462g disables both R153 and the unchanged R2176. Static GPR dependence is not experimental evidence of synthase activity or growth essentiality.
r153_model_interpretation.after: Gene-less since R153-GPR-UNASSIGNED-20261019: no single-gene knockout disables R153, so the model makes no gene-level prediction for argininosuccinate synthase. This reflects a missing W29 gene model, not evidence that the step needs no enzyme.

notes_added.r153_gpr_revision_authorization: 2026-10-19: user approved option A of model/reports/r153_ass_gpr_20261019/REPORT.md (gene-less R153 through a guarded post-merge step and opt-in flag, YALI1D17462g kept unlinked).
notes_added.r153_gpr_revision_basis: KEGG yli:90949668 / YALI2_D00589g (argininosuccinate synthase) is a Yarrowia lipolytica DSM 3286 gene (KEGG T01033, RefSeq GCF_014490615.1); its NCBI Gene record is discontinued and its RefSeq chromosome NC_089381.1 is suppressed. The current W29 RefSeq (NC_090773.1) has no YALI1 counterpart. Verified online 2026-10-19.
notes_added.r153_w29_locus: NC_090773.1 / CP017556.1 3604630-3609948, between YALI1_D36035g and YALI1_D36100g, carries no annotated feature. Argininosuccinate synthase homology there (3606992-3608481) splits across reading frames -3 and -1 (recorded 2026-09-11). Whether this is an assembly error, a strain variant or a pseudogene is unresolved.
notes_added.r153_identity_candidate: One identical 413-aa argininosuccinate synthase sequence in 11 Y. lipolytica strains, for example PO1f KAE8172175.1 (BKA90DRAFT_137900) and DSM 3286 QNP98148.1 (CDD cd01999, HAMAP MF_00005, TIGR00032). No verified native name; computational evidence only (database records and domain architecture). Not a W29 gene ID and not assigned to the GPR.
notes_added.r153_screen_coverage: No gene at the W29 argininosuccinate synthase locus is in the Cas9, Cas12a or Patterson Tn-seq gene sets, so the step has no experimental essentiality label.
notes_added.r153_unlinked_gene: YALI1D17462g (A1 aspartic peptidase candidate by automatic annotation) is kept in the model with no reactions.
notes_added.r153_gpr_revision_supersedes: Supersedes the GPR and current-status notes of R153-USER-SINGLE-GPR-20260915 (GPR YALI1D17462g); the previous note values are recorded in model/curation/gpr/r153_gpr_revision.json. The kept notes r153_previous_gpr, r153_authorization, r153_gene_function, r153_scope_limits, r153_superseded_assignment and reaction_merge_evidence describe the 2026-09-15 state and are history; the GPR immediately before this revision was YALI1D17462g.

evidence.claim: YALI1D17462g / NCBI Gene 2910235 is a live 'uncharacterized protein' gene on NC_090773.1:1746262-1747416; protein XP_502815.3, 384 aa, identical to AOW04049.1.

The protein carries Pfam PF00026, PROSITE PS51767 and PS00141 (76-87, 259-270) and CDD cd05474, and no argininosuccinate synthase signature (PF00764, PF20979, TIGR00032, cd01999, MF_00005, PS00564, PS00565).
KEGG yli:2910235 is '(RefSeq) Candidapepsin' (YALI2_D00285g) with no KO.
KEGG yli is Y. lipolytica DSM 3286 (RefSeq GCF_014490615.1), and yli:90949668 is its only gene linked to EC 6.3.4.5 and K01940.
NCBI Gene 90949668 (YALI2_D00589g, argininosuccinate synthase) is discontinued; NC_089381.1 (DSM 3286 chromosome D, from CP061015) is suppressed.
NC_090773.1 and CP017556.1 carry no feature from 3604630 to 3609948, and no chromosome 1D feature carries old_locus_tag YALI2_D00589g.
Twelve NCBI Protein records from Y. lipolytica strains (none W29/CLIB89 or CLIB122) share one 413-aa sequence with full argininosuccinate synthase architecture.
The W29 locus has argininosuccinate synthase homology split across two reading frames (TBLASTN against CP017556.1:3606000-3609500).
No gene between YALI1_D36035g and YALI1_D36100g is in the Cas9 or Cas12a gene sets (7,854 and 7,795 genes).
No gene between YALI1_D36035g and YALI1_D36100g is in Patterson 2018 Table S3 (Tn-seq; rows 5188/5189 are adjacent).
